serp_competitive_note: The two on-intent competitors (eq4c, River) are LOW-DR. High-DR domains in the broader SERP (myamericannurse.com ~DR60, rheumatologyadvisor.com ~DR70, PMC/JMIR .gov/.edu readability studies) rank for adjacent readability/prompt-engineering intent, not for the 'copy-paste nurse handout prompts' intent. A new domain can realistically compete on the long-tail nurse + real-prompts angle.
